NEOW: ……到了这里……你还记得来时的路么……
记得。事情办完，还得回去。
DARV: 这把剑用了很久吧！来，看看有什么能帮上你。
这些旧东西也陪我走过不少地方。你不嫌弃吧？
能用就行，之后我会好好保养。
哈哈，那它们可找对人了！
NONUPEIPE: 独行的骑士，若还要往上走，就带上这份力量吧。
你仍然把手留在剑柄上。还不肯放松吗？
直觉告诉我，现在还不能松手。
你已经走过很远的路，还要继续吗？
那么便带上力量，继续追寻。
OROBAS: 亮亮的甲！尖尖的剑！让我看看！？
又来了！又来了！这次也不摘头盔吗！？
只有一边！只有一边！另一只耳环呢！？
PAEL: 累了吧……把脚步停一会儿……
睡一会儿就好。剑得放在手边。
你的手还在动……梦里也握着剑吗……
梦里吹来的风……让你想起哪里……
那就记着它……好好歇一会儿……
TANX: 背着大剑的家伙！过来，让我试试你的本事！
又来啦！这回还要靠钩爪抢先手吗？
好！这一下比上次更重！还有力气吗？
痛快！拿上它，下次接着打！
TEZCATARA: 银亮的盔甲，连气息都是冷的。需要一点火吗，亲爱的？
还不肯让我看看头盔下面吗？
火能烧掉许多东西。你有什么不愿留下的吗？
烧掉刃口上的锈就够了，别的不用。
VAKUU: 一把旧剑，一身伤痕。你的执念能卖个好价钱。
你追得这样紧，就不怕前面什么也没有？
前面有没有东西，我会自己看。
再往前，可没人保证你还能回头。
去吧。看看你的脚步能把你带到哪里。
THE_ARCHITECT: 凭一把剑和一只钩爪，你便走到了这里。
到了这里，你还不肯停下。

NEOW: ...An unfamiliar scent... What do you pursue...?
...First, tell me where this path leads.
The scent remains. I can't stop.
...This far... Do you remember the way you came...?
I do. When it's done, I'm going back.
DARV: Now that's a well-used sword! Come, see what might help you.
Let me check the edge first.
You again! What are you looking for this time?
Something sturdy. It's a long road.
These old things have traveled a fair way with me. You don't mind, do you?
If they work. I'll maintain them.
Ha! Then they've found the right hands!
NONUPEIPE: Lone knight, accept this strength and climb onward.
Your hand still rests on the hilt. Can you not relax?
You have come a long way. Will you keep going?
Then take this strength and follow it.
OROBAS: Shiny armor! Pointy sword! Let me see!?
Back again! Back again! Still keeping the helmet on!?
Only one! Only one! Where's the other earring!?
PAEL: Tired...? Let your feet rest awhile...
For a while. The sword stays close.
Your hands still move... Holding a sword in your dreams, too...?
The wind in your dreams... Where does it take you...?
Somewhere I can still return to.
TANX: You with the greatsword! Come show me what you've got!
Back again! Going to steal the first move with that claw?
Good! Harder than last time! Any strength left?
That's the spirit! Take it, and we'll fight again!
TEZCATARA: Silver armor and a cold face. Need a little fire, darling?
Still won't show me what's beneath that helmet?
No need. The sword is here.
Fire can burn away so much. Anything you wish to leave behind?
Rust on the edge. Nothing else.
Very well. Just your sword, then.
VAKUU: An old sword and a body full of scars. Your obsession could fetch a fine price.
You chase so hard. What if nothing waits ahead?
Further on, no one can promise you'll be able to turn back.
Go on. See where those feet take you.
THE_ARCHITECT: A sword and a grappling claw brought you this far.
You have followed this trail all the way.
What if no path remains ahead?
Even here, you refuse to stop.
Then come and claim it yourself.
You would pass through here again?
